SADC_OPTIONS.description: Additional options passed to sadc when creating data files.

SA_DIR.description: Directory where daily data and report files are saved.

YESTERDAY.description: Whether sa2 should generate yesterday's summary (yes) or same-day summary (no).

ZIP.description: Program used to compress data and report files.

services.description: List of PAM service names the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators, and single * wildcard)

times.description: Time restrictions as logic list of day/time-range entries (e.g., Mo0900-1700, Wk1800-0800); supports ! prefix and standard day codes (Mo-Su, Wk, Wd, Al)

ttys.description: List of terminal (tty) names the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators, and single * wildcard)

users.description: List of users or netgroups the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators and single * wildcard; netgroups disallow wildcards and operators)

conf_force_conffnew.default: unset (script asks in case of doubt)
conf_force_conffnew.description: Force overriding the installed config file

conf_force_conffold.default: unset (script asks in case of doubt)
conf_force_conffold.description: Force retaining the installed config file

conf_old_mdsum_file.description: Explicit file to read historical md5sums from

conf_source_dir.description: Directory where historical md5sums for files are looked for

children_max.description: Maximum number of events executed in parallel; 0 means auto-determined.

event_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for an event to finish before termination.

exec_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) before executing each RUN{program} rule.

resolve_names.description: When to resolve user/group names: early (on rule parsing), late (per event), or never.

timeout_signal.description: Signal sent to workers and spawned processes on timeout.

encryption.description: Sets the default encryption technology for creating encrypted filesystems.

modules.description: Controls which modules should be loaded: a comma-separated list or '*' for all modules.

modules_load_preference.description: Specifies when to load plugins: on startup or on demand via D-Bus.

backup_initramfs.description: If set to yes, keeps a .bak backup of the previous initramfs.

update_initramfs.description: Controls whether initramfs updates are performed: yes (latest only), no (disabled), or all (all known initramfs).

PRUNEFS.description: Whitespace-separated list of file system types to skip during scanning.

PRUNENAMES.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory names to skip during scanning.

PRUNEPATHS.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory paths to skip during scanning.

PRUNE_BIND_MOUNTS.description: Whether to skip bind mounts (1/yes to skip).

enabled.description: When set to False, xdg-user-dirs-update will not change the XDG user dirs configuration.

filename_encoding.description: Sets the filename encoding to use (e.g., UTF-8 or locale).

DESKTOP.description: Default path for the Desktop directory, relative to the home directory.

DOCUMENTS.description: Default path for the Documents directory, relative to the home directory.

DOWNLOAD.description: Default path for the Downloads directory, relative to the home directory.

MUSIC.description: Default path for the Music directory, relative to the home directory.

PICTURES.description: Default path for the Pictures directory, relative to the home directory.

PUBLICSHARE.description: Default path for the Public share directory, relative to the home directory.

TEMPLATES.description: Default path for the Templates directory, relative to the home directory.

VIDEOS.description: Default path for the Videos directory, relative to the home directory.

comment.description: Comment or note about this user.

enabled.description: Whether this user is enabled or disabled.

dumpdir.description: Store resulting files to specified directory.

ionice.description: Set IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler.

keep-all.description: Keep all backups. Conflicts with other options when true.

keep-daily.description: Keep backups for the last N different days.

keep-hourly.description: Keep backups for the last N different hours.

keep-monthly.description: Keep backups for the last N different months.

keep-weekly.description: Keep backups for the last N different weeks.

keep-yearly.description: Keep backups for the last N different years.

lockwait.description: Maximal time to wait for the global lock (minutes).

mailnotification.description: Deprecated: use notification targets/matchers instead. Specify when to send a notification mail.

mailto.description: Deprecated: Use notification targets/matchers instead. Comma-separated list of email addresses or users that should receive email notifications.

max-workers.description: Allow up to this many IO workers at the same time for VMs.

notes-template.description: Template string for generating notes for the backup(s).

notification-mode.description: Determine which notification system to use.

pbs-change-detection-mode.description: PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups.

pbs-entries-max.description: Limits number of entries allowed in memory for container backups to PBS.

pigz.description: Use pigz instead of gzip when N>0.

pool.description: Backup all known guest systems included in the specified pool.

protected.description: If true, mark backup(s) as protected.

prune-backups.description: Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.

remove.description: Prune older backups according to prune-backups.

stopwait.description: Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped (minutes).

storage.description: Store resulting file to this storage.

tmpdir.description: Store temporary files to specified directory.

AccelerationThreshold.description: sets velocity threshold for acceleration to take effect

AdaptiveDeceleration.description: allows deceleration at low pointer speeds

AllowByteSwappedClients.description: allows clients with different byte-order than the server

AllowMouseOpenFail.description: tells mousedrv/vmmouse not to report failure if mouse can't be opened

AllowNonLocalXvidtune.description: allows xvidtune to connect from another host

AutoAddDevices.description: enables automatic input device addition from HAL/udev

AutoAddGPU.description: enables automatic GPU device addition from udev

AutoBindGPU.description: enables automatic secondary GPU setup as output-sources

AutoEnableDevices.description: enables automatic device enabling after adding

AutoServerLayout.description: always adds the device to the ServerLayout section

BlankTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for blank phase of screensaver (minutes)

BusID.description: specifies the bus location of the graphics card

Chipset.description: specifies the chipset used on the graphics board

Clocks.description: specifies pixel clocks supported by the graphics board

ConstantDeceleration.description: multiplies pointer speed by a constant factor

DisableVidModeExtension.description: disables VidMode extension parts used by xvidtune

DisplaySize.description: specifies physical width/height of monitor in mm

DontVTSwitch.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Fn sequence for virtual terminal switching

DontZap.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Backspace to terminate X server

Floating.description: sets up device floating (no event reporting via master device)

FontPath.description: sets the search path for fonts

GlxVisuals.description: controls how many GLX visuals are set up

HTimings.description: horizontal timings for a video mode

IgnoreABI.description: allows modules built for a different X server version to load

IndirectGLX.description: enables or disables indirect GLX contexts

Load.description: loads a specified Xorg server module

MatchDriver.description: matches kernel driver name for outputs

MatchProduct.description: matches substring in device's product name

MatchSeat.description: matches seat ID from -seat server option

MatchVendor.description: matches substring in device's vendor name

MaxClients.description: sets maximum number of clients allowed to connect

MemBase.description: specifies linear frame buffer base address

ModeLine.description: compact definition for a video mode

ModulePath.description: sets the search path for loadable Xorg server modules

NoMatchProduct.description: negative match for product name substring

NoMatchTag.description: negative match for config backend tags

NoMatchVendor.description: negative match for vendor name substring

NoOutputInitialSize.description: overrides screen size when no outputs are connected

OffTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS off phase (minutes)

Position.description: specifies position of monitor (x y coordinates)

PreferCloneMode.description: prefers clone mode for monitors over horizontal extend

PreferredMode.description: specifies preferred initial video mode for monitor

Screen.description: specifies which display head this device applies to

StandbyTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS standby phase (minutes)

SuspendTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS suspend phase (minutes)

SyncOnGreen.description: drives sync signal on green color pin

TransformationMatrix.description: 3x3 transformation matrix for absolute input devices

UseDefaultFontPath.description: includes default font path even if other paths are specified

UseModes.description: includes video modes from named Modes section

VScan.description: number of times each scanline is painted

VTimings.description: vertical timings for a video mode

VideoRam.description: specifies video RAM size in kBytes

XkbDir.description: sets the base directory for keyboard layout files

ZoomModes.description: specifies modes for zoom switching via keypad

EnableProcessId.description: Includes process ID in log messages.

able_token_login.description: Requires username and password during initial connection.

background.description: Hex RGB background color for login/log window.

black.description: Hex RGB color for black (login/log window).

bulk_compression.description: Enables compression of bulk data in xrdp(8).

channel_code.description: Disables all channels if set to false.

chansrvport.description: xrdp-chansrv display or domain socket path.

cliprdr.description: Enables RDP channel for clipboard redirection.

crypt_level.description: Regulates encryption level of Standard RDP Security.

dark_blue.description: Hex RGB color for dark blue.

dark_grey.description: Hex RGB color for dark grey.

disabled_encodings_mask.description: Bitmask to disable Xvnc server encodings.

fork.description: Forks a subprocess for each connection if enabled.

hidelogwindow.description: Hides the log messages window if enabled.

ip.description: IP address of host to connect to.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file.

max_bpp.description: Maximum color depth (bits per pixel) allowed.

name.description: Display name of connection in login window.

omain_user_separator.description: Separator to append domain name to username.

pamerrortxt.description: Error text passed to PAM on authentication failure.

port.description: Port to connect to (-1 for default).

rail.description: Enables RDP channel for remote applications (RAIL).

rdpdr.description: Enables RDP channel for device redirection.

require_credentials.description: Treats domain separator in username as autologon.

security_layer.description: Security method: TLS, RDP, or negotiate.

tcp_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Size of TCP receive buffer in bytes.

tcp_send_buffer_bytes.description: Size of TCP send buffer in bytes.

xrdpvr.description: Enables RDP channel for XRDP video streaming.

xserverbpp.description: Color depth of backend X server (bpp).

security.description: Authentication mode of the Samba server.

server role.description: The role this Samba server plays.

map to guest.description: When to map a failed login to the guest account.

browseable.description: Whether the share shows up in the browse list.

browsable.description: Whether the share shows up in the browse list.

writable.description: Whether the share is writable (inverse of read only).

writeable.description: Whether the share is writable (inverse of read only).

guest ok.description: Whether no password is required to connect to the share.

load printers.description: Whether to load all printers from the printcap for browsing.

read raw.description: Whether the server supports raw read SMB requests.

write raw.description: Whether the server supports raw write SMB requests.

UseReverseDNS.description: Resolve client IPs to hostnames in logs.

IdentLookups.description: Perform RFC1413 ident lookups on connecting clients.

RequireValidShell.description: Require the login user to have a valid shell in /etc/shells.

AllowOverwrite.description: Allow uploads to overwrite existing files.

DeferWelcome.description: Delay the welcome banner until after login.

LogLevel.description: Verbosity of the CUPS error log.

udp.description: Accept NFS over UDP (NFSv4 is TCP-only).

threads.description: Number of kernel nfsd threads (RPC concurrency).
